## What's new

- **A Now Playing widget.** Put Kultr on your home screen or lock screen: what's playing with its artwork, a progress bar that runs by itself, and play/pause (and skip, on the medium size) right on the widget. Long-press the home screen → **Edit** → **Add Widget** → **Kultr**. Sizes: small and medium for the home screen, a line and a ring for the lock screen.
  - The widget is an extra part of the app. With a free Apple ID that counts as one more app towards the limit of 3, so if SideStore or AltStore says you've reached it, let it remove the widget — Kultr works the same without it.
  - Tapping play when nothing is loaded picks up where you left off.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` in SideStore and update from there.

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
